_what: Lattice of points REACHABLE from the PlayerStart across the built navmesh, measured by BFS over adjacent cells. Unlike the town sidecar this covers ground OUTSIDE the settlement, which is what a placement tool needs to ask about.
_method: Grid BFS: a cell joins when a path exists from an already-reachable 4-neighbour, so every query is one lattice step. A single long query from the plaza hits the pathfinder's SEARCH BUDGET and returns FAIL, which is not 'no path exists' -- that error is what made this project believe the basin was sealed.
